fixes.explanation: Scattered? Nobody gets scattered in this verse, baker. The text says many of the Corinthians who heard the message believed and were baptized (Acts 18:8). I think it's the happiest line in the whole passage, so I'm not letting anyone scatter it.

Land? Nobody's fighting about land, baker. Gallio calls it “…a dispute about words and names and your own law…” (Acts 18:15). I bet he'd have been just as done with a land fight. He says he refuses to be a judge of such things.
